subject: MdeModulePkg/PeiDebugLibDebugPpi: Fix comma parsing in VaListToBaseList
reasons: Paired with adjacent commit 4d0946c082 applying the identical fix to PeiDxeDebugLibReportStatusCode/DebugLib.c
Both commits add || (*Format == ',') to the same format-flag parsing condition in mirrored debug library files
Likely more instances exist across other DebugLib implementations that parse format strings — pattern is well-defined and mechanical
candidate_pattern: Match: if ((*Format == '.') || (*Format == '-') || (*Format == '+') || (*Format == ' ')) inside format-string parsing loops in DebugLib files, and add || (*Format == ',') to the condition.
